The badges distinguish **all catalog services** (including limited/expiring offers), **free tiers** (ongoing allowances and recurring credits), **limited offers** (time-limited or expiring resources), and **New (48h)** (services first published in the last 48 hours, across all offer types). **New (48h) is not an updated/re-verified count**: editing a listing or changing its `last_checked` date does not make it new again.
